caution_findings.evidence_context: Six DBAASP assay/experiment rows carry MIC 2 ug/mL but use Staphylococcus aureus 209P, Smith, or MRSA clinical-isolate labels that are not the ATCC 29213/ATCC 33591 strains named in the local primary SI.
Merged DBAASP sequence catalog uses GXAXXXDC while the primary paper reports GPAVVFDC as the precursor-encoded sequence; X placeholders were preserved instead of normalized.
The OA package includes an SI PDF that was text-indexed and checked for MIC/method details; no separate spreadsheet/table supplement was present in the local packet.
The local source supports bacteriostatic phenotypic action and RiPP biosynthetic evidence, but not a source-reviewed direct molecular killing target for Bottromycin D.
